# ===== Colony fleets (slices 2-3 design §§ 4-7) =====
# A colony's goal at each stage (the races-only bar reads the current stage's
# through sr_solar_colonization_goal, space_race_values.txt).
sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 = { value = 400 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 = { value = 450 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 = { value = 500 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 = { value = 550 }
sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 = { value = 650 }
sr_cf_horizon_months = { value = 180 }
sr_cf_no_score = { value = -1000 }

# Per world, country scope:
#   sr_cf_goal_<key>     its colony's goal: its own stage's under simple and full, the
#                        current stage's under races only (a released world costs that)
#   sr_cf_cost_<key>     what a fleet leaving now spends: goal x (1 + premium);
#                        sr_launch_never's x goal when it can't leave
#   sr_cf_arrival_<key>  the month a fleet leaving now lands, by THIS's drive
#   sr_cf_score_<key>    the automatic pick: 100 - 10 x stage - transit / 2 - 40 x premium
#                        - 10 a fleet inbound - 60 if one lands first
sr_cf_goal_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1
	if = { limit = { NOT = { sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes } } value = sr_solar_colonization_goal }
}
sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_launch_target_cost_mars
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_cf_goal_valles_marineris
}
sr_cf_arrival_valles_marineris = {
	value = te_history_month_index
	add = sr_transit_months_mars
}
sr_cf_score_valles_marineris = {
	value = 90
	subtract = { value = sr_transit_months_mars divide = 2 }
	subtract = { value = sr_launch_target_cost_mars multiply = 40 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris } subtract = { value = global_var:sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris multiply = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_beaten_valles_marineris = yes } subtract = 60 }
	min = -900
}

	if = { limit = { sr_cf_beaten_himalia = yes } subtract = 60 }
	min = -900
}

# The best score among the eligible worlds; sr_cf_no_score when none is.
sr_cf_best_score = {
	value = sr_cf_no_score
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_valles_marineris = yes } min = sr_cf_score_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_olympus_mons = yes } min = sr_cf_score_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_hellas_planitia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_utopia_planitia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_arcadia_planitia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_ceres = yes } min = sr_cf_score_ceres }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_vesta = yes } min = sr_cf_score_vesta }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_psyche = yes } min = sr_cf_score_psyche }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_pallas = yes } min = sr_cf_score_pallas }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_hygiea = yes } min = sr_cf_score_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_io = yes } min = sr_cf_score_io }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_europa = yes } min = sr_cf_score_europa }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_ganymede = yes } min = sr_cf_score_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_callisto = yes } min = sr_cf_score_callisto }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_himalia = yes } min = sr_cf_score_himalia }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_amalthea = yes } min = sr_cf_score_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_venus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_venus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_mercury = yes } min = sr_cf_score_mercury }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_titan = yes } min = sr_cf_score_titan }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_enceladus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_rhea = yes } min = sr_cf_score_rhea }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_mimas = yes } min = sr_cf_score_mimas }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_iapetus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_titania = yes } min = sr_cf_score_titania }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_oberon = yes } min = sr_cf_score_oberon }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_miranda = yes } min = sr_cf_score_miranda }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_ariel = yes } min = sr_cf_score_ariel }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_triton = yes } min = sr_cf_score_triton }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_proteus = yes } min = sr_cf_score_proteus }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_pluto = yes } min = sr_cf_score_pluto }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_eris = yes } min = sr_cf_score_eris }
	if = { limit = { sr_cf_eligible_makemake = yes } min = sr_cf_score_makemake }

# The target's goal (sr_solar_colonization_goal under simple and full).
sr_cf_target_goal = {
	value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 1 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 2 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 3 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 4 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 5 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 6 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 7 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 8 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 9 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 10 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 11 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 12 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 13 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 14 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 15 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 16 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 17 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_2 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 18 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 19 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 20 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 21 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 22 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 23 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_3 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 24 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 25 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 26 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 27 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 28 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 29 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_4 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 30 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 31 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 32 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 33 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_target var:sr_cf_target = 34 } value = sr_colonization_goal_stage_5 }

# ===== Population (slices 2-3 design § 10) =====
sr_site_crew_per_level = { value = 5000 }

# Per world, any scope: its base room (people, before Habitats), its room (+50% of
# the base a Habitat level, slice 4 design § 3), its people, its free room, and
# the module levels above the first its people can crew. Country scope:
# THIS's priority weight for it (Closed 0, Low 1, Normal 2, High 4; Normal when
# unset) and its emigration weight, priority x free room, 0 unless THIS holds it.
sr_site_base_room_valles_marineris = { value = 50000 }
sr_site_room_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = 0.5
	add = 1
	multiply = sr_site_base_room_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_pop_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_free_room_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_room_valles_marineris
	subtract = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	min = 0
}
sr_site_fill_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	divide = sr_site_room_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_crews_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	divide = sr_site_crew_per_level
	floor = yes
}
sr_emig_prio_weight_valles_marineris = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris var:sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris = 0 } value = 0 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris var:sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris = 1 } value = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris var:sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris = 3 } value = 4 }
}
sr_emig_weight_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_valles_marineris } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } } value = sr_emig_prio_weight_valles_marineris multiply = sr_site_free_room_valles_marineris }
}

# ===== Modules (slice 4 design §§ 2-4, 7-8) =====
sr_mod_spec_budget = { value = 4 }

# Per world, any scope:
#   sr_site_lvl_<a|b>_value_<key>  a specialization's level; the founding choice
#                                  reads 1 until a module raises it, the other 0
#   sr_site_<hab|def|port>_value_<key>  a generic module's level
#   sr_site_levels_<key>          the levels that need crews (Habitats house them)
#   sr_site_extra_levels_<key>    every module level past the founding outpost's
#   sr_site_staffing_<key>        1 with the crews, AGI or under races only; else
#                                  (crews + 1) / levels (design § 4)
#   sr_site_mult_<a|b>_<key>      a specialization's multiplier: level x staffing
#                                  x the charter's share (slice 5 design § 2)
#   sr_site_<spec|generic>_built_<key>  the levels against each cap
# Country scope, counting THIS's queue and every shipment on its way:
#   sr_mod_spec_used_<key>, sr_mod_slots_used_<key>
sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_valles_marineris }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 1 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_valles_marineris }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 2 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_hab_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_def_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_port_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_port_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_levels_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_port_value_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_extra_levels_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_levels_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_levels_valles_marineris
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_valles_marineris = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_valles_marineris < sr_site_crew_needed_valles_marineris
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_valles_marineris
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_valles_marineris
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_valles_marineris
}
sr_site_mult_b_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_valles_marineris
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_valles_marineris } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_spec_built_valles_marineris = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_valles_marineris add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_valles_marineris }
sr_site_generic_built_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_hab_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris
	add = sr_site_port_value_valles_marineris
}
sr_mod_spec_used_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_spec_built_valles_marineris
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_a_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_a_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_a_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_a_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_b_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_valles_marineris }
}
sr_mod_slots_used_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_valles_marineris
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_hab_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_def_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_def_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_port_valles_marineris } add = var:sr_mq_port_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_valles_marineris } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_valles_marineris }
}

			sr_site_crews_venus < sr_site_crew_needed_venus

		}
		value = sr_site_crews_venus
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_venus
	}
}

		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_mimas
	}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_b_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_b_makemake }
}
sr_mod_slots_used_makemake = {
	value = sr_site_generic_built_makemake
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_hab_makemake } add = var:sr_mq_hab_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_hab_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_hab_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_def_makemake } add = var:sr_mq_def_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_def_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_def_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_port_makemake } add = var:sr_mq_port_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_ship_port_makemake } add = global_var:sr_site_ship_port_makemake }
}
sr_site_lvl_a_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_a_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_a_haumea }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_haumea global_var:sr_site_spec_haumea = 1 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_lvl_b_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_lvl_b_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_lvl_b_haumea }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_haumea global_var:sr_site_spec_haumea = 2 } value = 1 }
}
sr_site_hab_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_hab_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_hab_haumea }
}
sr_site_def_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_def_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_def_haumea }
}
sr_site_port_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_port_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_port_haumea }
}
sr_site_levels_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_def_value_haumea
	add = sr_site_port_value_haumea
}
sr_site_extra_levels_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_levels_haumea
	add = sr_site_hab_value_haumea
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_crew_needed_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_levels_haumea
	subtract = 1
	min = 0
}
sr_site_staffing_haumea = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			sr_site_crews_haumea < sr_site_crew_needed_haumea
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= { has_technology_researched = artificial_intelligence } }
		}
		value = sr_site_crews_haumea
		add = 1
		divide = sr_site_levels_haumea
	}
}
sr_site_mult_a_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_haumea
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_haumea
}
sr_site_mult_b_haumea = {
	value = sr_site_lvl_b_value_haumea
	multiply = sr_site_staffing_haumea
	multiply = sr_site_charter_factor_haumea
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_haumea } multiply = 0 }
}
sr_site_spec_built_haumea = { value = sr_site_lvl_a_value_haumea add = sr_site_lvl_b_value_haumea }
sr_site_generic_built_haumea = {

	add = sr_site_port_value_haumea

	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_mq_b_haumea } add = var:sr_mq_b_haumea }

# Country scope: THIS's Extraplanetary Base room, in levels (design § 9): the
# near-Earth 10 and every colony it holds.
sr_ebase_room_total = {
	value = 10
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_valles_marineris } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } } add = 40 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_olympus_mons } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_olympus_mons } } add = 30 }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_hellas_planitia } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_hellas_planitia } } add = 40 }

	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_blockaded_ceres } NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ceres } } add = 40 }

# ===== Autonomy and free colonies (slice 5 design §§ 2-3) =====
# Per world, any scope: its autonomy (0 absent), the months since contact from
# Earth, the charter's share of its specializations, a free colony's suppliers.
# Holder scope: its autonomy's drift a month (the terms are
# sr_colony_autonomy_values.txt's). Country scope: THIS's ties with a free
# colony and its share of the colony's trade, in units.
sr_site_autonomy_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_autonomy_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_months_since_contact_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_valles_marineris } value = te_history_month_index subtract = global_var:sr_site_contact_valles_marineris }
	min = 0
}
sr_site_aut_drift_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_aut_home_pull
	add = { value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris divide = 10000 multiply = sr_aut_per_10k_people }
	add = { value = sr_transit_months_mars multiply = sr_aut_per_transit_month max = sr_aut_distance_cap }
	if = { limit = { sr_site_months_since_contact_valles_marineris > sr_aut_no_contact_months } add = sr_aut_no_contact }
	if = { limit = { is_at_war = yes } add = sr_aut_at_war }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_valles_marineris } add = sr_aut_garrisoned }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_valles_marineris } add = sr_aut_chartered }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_destroyed_colony_until var:sr_destroyed_colony_until > te_history_month_index } add = sr_aut_destroyed_colony }
}
sr_site_charter_factor_valles_marineris = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_valles_marineris } value = sr_aut_charter_share }
}
sr_site_suppliers_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_suppliers_valles_marineris }
}
sr_free_ties_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_valles_marineris } value = var:sr_free_ties_valles_marineris }
}
sr_free_trade_share_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_valles_marineris has_global_variable = sr_site_free_valles_marineris }
		value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
		divide = sr_free_trade_people_per_unit

}
sr_site_suppliers_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_haumea } value = global_var:sr_site_suppliers_haumea }
}
sr_free_ties_value_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_haumea } value = var:sr_free_ties_haumea }
}
sr_free_trade_share_haumea = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_haumea has_global_variable = sr_site_free_haumea }
		value = sr_site_pop_value_haumea
		divide = sr_free_trade_people_per_unit
		divide = { value = sr_site_suppliers_value_haumea min = 1 }
	}
}
sr_site_autonomy_value_sedna = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_autonomy_sedna } value = global_var:sr_site_autonomy_sedna }
}
sr_site_months_since_contact_sedna = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_contact_sedna } value = te_history_month_index subtract = global_var:sr_site_contact_sedna }
	min = 0
}
sr_site_aut_drift_sedna = {
	value = sr_aut_home_pull
	add = { value = sr_site_pop_value_sedna divide = 10000 multiply = sr_aut_per_10k_people }
	add = { value = sr_transit_months_kuiper multiply = sr_aut_per_transit_month max = sr_aut_distance_cap }
	if = { limit = { sr_site_months_since_contact_sedna > sr_aut_no_contact_months } add = sr_aut_no_contact }
	if = { limit = { is_at_war = yes } add = sr_aut_at_war }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_garrison_sedna } add = sr_aut_garrisoned }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_sedna } add = sr_aut_chartered }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_destroyed_colony_until var:sr_destroyed_colony_until > te_history_month_index } add = sr_aut_destroyed_colony }
}
sr_site_charter_factor_sedna = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_charter_sedna } value = sr_aut_charter_share }
}
sr_site_suppliers_value_sedna = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_suppliers_sedna } value = global_var:sr_site_suppliers_sedna }
}
sr_free_ties_value_sedna = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_free_ties_sedna } value = var:sr_free_ties_sedna }
}
sr_free_trade_share_sedna = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_free_supply_sedna has_global_variable = sr_site_free_sedna }
		value = sr_site_pop_value_sedna
		divide = sr_free_trade_people_per_unit
		divide = { value = sr_site_suppliers_value_sedna min = 1 }
	}
}

# ===== Fleets: defences, integrity, marines, occupation (slice 6 design §§ 7-10) =====
# Per world, any scope:
#   sr_site_marines_value_<key>    battalions standing there (the holder's; the
#                                  occupier's while occupied)
#   sr_site_integrity_value_<key>  0-100, 100 while unset
#   sr_site_militia_value_<key>    a battalion a sr_militia_people, at least one
#   sr_site_garrison_need_<key>    the marines a seizure must exceed: garrison and militia
#   sr_site_def_fire_<key>         its Defences' fire on fleets closing in: 15 a level x
#                                  1.5 (+25% Orbital Weapon Platforms, its holder's) x
#                                  integrity; nothing while occupied
#   sr_site_hardness_<key>         50 + 50 a Defences level
#   sr_site_target_strength_<key>  what draws a closing-in fleet's defence fire from
#                                  stationed hostiles: its Defences and its hull
#   sr_site_ws_weight_<key>        its weight in war support, 0.1 to 0.25 by its people
sr_site_marines_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_marines_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_marines_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_integrity_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_integrity_full
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_integrity_valles_marineris } value = global_var:sr_site_integrity_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_militia_value_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	divide = sr_militia_people
	floor = yes
	min = 1
}
# A seizure must exceed the garrison and the militia; a liberation, the
# occupier's garrison alone (its people are the holder's).
sr_site_garrison_need_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_marines_value_valles_marineris
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } } add = sr_site_militia_value_valles_marineris }
}
sr_site_def_fire_valles_marineris = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris } sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris > 0 }
		value = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris
		multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
		multiply = sr_def_fire_factor
		if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { has_technology_researched = orbital_weapon_platforms } } multiply = 1.25 }
		multiply = { value = sr_site_integrity_value_valles_marineris divide = sr_integrity_full }
	}
}
sr_site_hardness_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_def_hardness_per_level
	add = sr_def_hardness_base
}
sr_site_target_strength_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_valles_marineris
	multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
	add = sr_def_hull_strength
}
sr_site_ws_weight_valles_marineris = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_valles_marineris
	divide = sr_ws_colony_full_people
	max = 1
	multiply = sr_ws_colony_growth
	add = sr_ws_colony_base
}

	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_marines_olympus_mons } value = global_var:sr_site_marines_olympus_mons }

	divide = sr_ws_colony_full_people
	max = 1
	multiply = sr_ws_colony_growth
	add = sr_ws_colony_base
}
sr_site_marines_value_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_marines_arcadia_planitia } value = global_var:sr_site_marines_arcadia_planitia }
}
sr_site_integrity_value_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = sr_integrity_full
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_integrity_arcadia_planitia } value = global_var:sr_site_integrity_arcadia_planitia }
}
sr_site_militia_value_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_arcadia_planitia
	divide = sr_militia_people
	floor = yes
	min = 1
}
# A seizure must exceed the garrison and the militia; a liberation, the
# occupier's garrison alone (its people are the holder's).
sr_site_garrison_need_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_marines_value_arcadia_planitia
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_arcadia_planitia } } add = sr_site_militia_value_arcadia_planitia }
}
sr_site_def_fire_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_arcadia_planitia } sr_site_def_value_arcadia_planitia > 0 }
		value = sr_site_def_value_arcadia_planitia
		multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
		multiply = sr_def_fire_factor
		if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= { has_technology_researched = orbital_weapon_platforms } } multiply = 1.25 }
		multiply = { value = sr_site_integrity_value_arcadia_planitia divide = sr_integrity_full }
	}
}
sr_site_hardness_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_arcadia_planitia
	multiply = sr_def_hardness_per_level
	add = sr_def_hardness_base
}
sr_site_target_strength_arcadia_planitia = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_arcadia_planitia
	multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
	add = sr_def_hull_strength
}

	divide = sr_militia_people
	floor = yes
	min = 1
}
# A seizure must exceed the garrison and the militia; a liberation, the
# occupier's garrison alone (its people are the holder's).
sr_site_garrison_need_amalthea = {
	value = sr_site_marines_value_amalthea
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_amalthea } } add = sr_site_militia_value_amalthea }
}
sr_site_def_fire_amalthea = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_amalthea } sr_site_def_value_amalthea > 0 }
		value = sr_site_def_value_amalthea
		multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
		multiply = sr_def_fire_factor
		if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_amalthea ?= { has_technology_researched = orbital_weapon_platforms } } multiply = 1.25 }
		multiply = { value = sr_site_integrity_value_amalthea divide = sr_integrity_full }
	}
}
sr_site_hardness_amalthea = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_amalthea
	multiply = sr_def_hardness_per_level
	add = sr_def_hardness_base
}
sr_site_target_strength_amalthea = {
	value = sr_site_def_value_amalthea
	multiply = sr_def_strength_per_level
	add = sr_def_hull_strength
}
sr_site_ws_weight_amalthea = {
	value = sr_site_pop_value_amalthea
	divide = sr_ws_colony_full_people
	max = 1
	multiply = sr_ws_colony_growth
	add = sr_ws_colony_base
}

# Country scope: war support from occupied colonies (design § 10), a beat: each
# world THIS occupies from a holder it is at war with, less each of its own an
# enemy occupies. The fleets' month stores it (sr_ws_colonies_net), so the
# injection reads one variable.
sr_ws_colonies_sum = {
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_olympus_mons ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_olympus_mons ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_hellas_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_hellas_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_utopia_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_utopia_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_arcadia_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_arcadia_planitia ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_ceres ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_ceres }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_ceres ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_ceres }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_vesta ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_vesta }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_vesta ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_vesta }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_psyche ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_psyche }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_psyche ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_psyche }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_pallas ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_pallas }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_pallas ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_pallas }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_hygiea ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_hygiea ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_io ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_io }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_io ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_io }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_europa ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_europa }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_europa ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_europa }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_ganymede ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_ganymede ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_ganymede }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_callisto ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_callisto }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_callisto ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_callisto }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_himalia ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_himalia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_himalia ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_himalia }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_amalthea ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_amalthea ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_amalthea ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_amalthea ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_amalthea }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_venus ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_venus }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_venus ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_venus }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_mercury ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_mercury }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_mercury ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_mercury }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_titan ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_titan ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_titan }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titan ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_titan ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_titan }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_occupier_enceladus ?= this global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= { has_war_with = root } } add = sr_site_ws_weight_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= this global_var:sr_site_occupier_enceladus ?= { has_war_with = root } } subtract = sr_site_ws_weight_enceladus }
